products.name: Corporate-Owned (COD) & BYOD Device Management — Commercial
products.short_description: One account, both devices. Manage corporate-owned and personal (BYOD) devices under a single Microsoft Entra identity in Intune — full control where you own it, data-only protection where you don't. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
One identity across every device — company-owned and personal

Most organizations juggle two device worlds: corporate-owned devices IT fully controls, and personal devices employees already use for work. Managed separately they breed duplicate policies, inconsistent security, and frustrated users. This solution unifies both in Microsoft Intune under one Microsoft Entra identity — the same account signs in on the company device and the personal one — while IT applies the right level of control to each based on who owns it.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant to design this. The package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a non-expert administrator can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell (Microsoft Graph) that builds the filters, audits ownership, and validates the result.

  • Simpler — exact Intune and Entra navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Assign once to the user; ownership-based filters route the right policy to each device automatically.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable endpoint-management consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with eight validation tests and clear pass/fail gates, proving one account works on both a corporate and a personal device before you scale.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the two ownership models, the single-identity design, and which management model to use for each (full MDM for COD, App Protection for BYOD).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (one identity, MDM+MAM licensing, Entra ID P1, enrollment restrictions, corporate tagging, App Protection, compliance, ownership filters, network) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, click-by-click steps across six phases: identity & enrollment baseline, ownership-based targeting, COD full-MDM, BYOD App Protection, unifying access with Conditional Access, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant-readiness discovery, one-identity/two-device validation, a tenant-wide ownership report (incl. users who own both a COD and a BYOD device), safe ownership remediation, and a one-shot builder for the Corporate/Personal device filters.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-to-user/scope-by-filter model.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A single, coherent model where one employee account works on both a corporate and a personal device, corporate data stays protected on each, and access is governed by compliance or app protection through one Conditional Access policy — deployable by a single administrator in a controlled pilot.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CODBYOD-DeviceReport.ps1 — tenant inventory by ownership, plus users who have both COD and BYOD
    • CODBYOD-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for COD + BYOD device management
    • CODBYOD-Remediation.ps1 — safe fixes for ownership and policy targeting
    • CODBYOD-Validation.ps1 — prove one identity owns both a Corporate and a Personal device
    • Set-OwnershipBasedTargeting.ps1 — create the Corporate & Personal device filters

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
